sms.preview: KolektaPH: {{barangay}}, 15 min na lang bago dumating ang garbage truck (~7:40 AM). Ilabas na po ang basura. Salamat!

sms.otpDemo: This is a demo, so no real text is sent. The code is {{code}}.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.draft: Prototype draft. To be reviewed by the city's Data Protection Officer.
privacy.collectBody: Only your barangay. If you want text alerts, also your mobile number. We don't need your name, address or ID.
privacy.whyBody: To show your barangay's schedule and text you before the truck arrives.
privacy.whoBody: Only the City ENRO, to send reminders. It is never sold or shared.
privacy.rightsBody: You can stop texts anytime (reply STOP) and delete your data in Settings. This follows the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173).

sms.title: SMS and announcements
sms.typhoon: KolektaPH: Walang koleksyon ng basura ngayong araw dahil sa bagyo. Itabi muna po ang basura sa ligtas na lugar. Salamat po.
sms.cleanup: KolektaPH: May clean-up drive sa Sabado, 7AM. Sama-sama nating linisin ang ating barangay. Salamat po!
sms.segregation: KolektaPH: Paalala po: ihiwalay ang nabubulok at di-nabubulok. Hindi kukunin ang basurang hindi nakahiwalay. Salamat po!
sms.messageHint: Write in plain Filipino. One SMS (160 characters) is cheapest.
sms.ucsWarning: Contains a special character (e.g. emoji or curly quotes): only 70 characters fit per SMS.
sms.confirmBody: This can't be undone once sent.
sms.arrived: Truck arrived at {{time}} ({{minutes}} min after the text).
sms.arrivedEarly: Truck arrived at {{time}}, before the text.
